resourceName: Bionersis landfill  project in Pasto, Colombia
description: The small-scale project activity is to build, operate and maintain a landfill gas collection and flaring system on the Antanas landfill in Pasto, Colombia. It is an anaerobic managed landfill, owned by the municipality of Pasto and managed by Empresa Metropolitana de Aseo de Pasto (EMAS – Pasto S.A.E.S.P.). The landfill started operations in April 2001 and will close in 2034. Since its opening, the landfill has received approximately 600,000 tons of solid waste from the municipality of Pasto and neighbouring municipalities. It currently receives 220 tons of waste per day. The landfill is covered with clay and vegetal soil on areas which do not receive waste anymore. The location details of the landfill are provided in section A4. The equipment includes inter alia a gas collection network, a high temperature enclosed flare, monitoring and control systems and civil works.At a later stage, the landfill gas collected may be used as fuel for electricity generation.
